admin.description: Built in administrator of the OrangeHRM demo instance

invalidPassword.description: Valid user name with the wrong password

unknownUser.description: User name that does not exist

emptyCredentials.description: Both fields left blank to trigger client side validation

missingPassword.description: Valid user name with the password left blank

lowercaseAdmin.description: The administrator name in lower case, to pin whether the field is case sensitive

paddedAdmin.description: The administrator name with surrounding whitespace, as a paste from a document leaves it

wrongCasePassword.description: The right password in the wrong case - a password must be case sensitive

overlongUsername.description: A username far longer than any real one, to prove the form rejects rather than breaks
